summary: Skyasterix reviews the Fire legendary support hero Munch, available through the Continental Challenge event. Munch functions as a specialized shield counter and control hero who deals extra damage against shielded enemies. His kit grants Accuracy Up to allies, inflicts Accuracy Down on enemies, and provides an area-of-effect Stun on his Ultimate. He is best suited for PvP Arena against shield-heavy teams, as well as specific PvE encounters like Harpy and Fey Meander.

heroes.name: Munch
heroes.note: Deals passive bonus damage to shielded targets, grants Accuracy Up to allies, applies Accuracy Down to enemies, and stuns with his Ultimate.

meta_changes: Introduction of Munch as a Fire support hero designed to hard-counter shield-reliant compositions.
tips: Use Munch in Arena offense to counter shield-heavy defensive teams.
Pair Munch with accuracy-dependent debuffers to benefit from his team-wide Accuracy Up buff.
